homeRoot.description: Visible top-level $HOME entries this estate sanctions. Anything visible and unlisted WARNs as home-root clutter (2026-08-02 audit follow-up: the ~/.claude policies could not see sprawl landing in $HOME itself). Hidden entries are app-managed and out of scope.

boundaryRules.name: external-runtime-isolation
boundaryRules.forbiddenPatternsNote: DETECTORS, NOT DRIFT — do not 'clean up' the machine-specific spellings below. verify_claude_runtime_coupling.py matches these as plain SUBSTRINGS (never regexes: the Windows entries contain \U escapes that crash re.compile), so each host spelling an Antigravity reference could take needs its own entry. The Windows forms are retained regression guards from the pre-Mac era; the absolute /Users form catches a pinned Mac reference the ~ form cannot. Deleting any of them silently narrows the gate.

allowlist.reason: Cross-home GC is this script's documented purpose (see rules/mechanisms.md 'Retention Reaper'; first run reclaimed 604MB). It deliberately reaps ~/.claude AND ~/.gemini/antigravity in one bounded pass — the antigravity reference is the design, not drift.
The antigravity string is a provenance _comment ('Ported from ~/.gemini/antigravity/safety/hook_policies.json, 2026-04-18'), documentary history — not a functional runtime coupling.

Enforcement self-reference: this verifier's own invariant scan declares '.gemini/antigravity' as the forbidden needle it searches for, and its allowlist comment documents retention_reaper's sanctioned cross-home reach. Same class as the pack's policy files declaring forbiddenPatterns — the string IS the check, not a coupling.

Design note (2026-07-17) that diagnosed the retention_reaper coupling as an intentional bridge and prescribed allowlisting it — the antigravity strings are quoted evidence in prose, not runtime code. Documentation of the boundary decision, not a violation of it.

boundaryRules.description: Live Claude runtime surfaces must not reference Antigravity-owned paths (except allowlisted intentional/documented references).

boundaryRules.name: historical-surface-isolation

allowlist.reason: This script IS the producer of ~/.claude/backups/ — the daily backup job (com.claude.daily-backup.plist) writes and prunes claude-backup-*.zip there. Referencing its own output directory is not a stale dependency on a historical surface.

boundaryRules.description: Historical and recovery surfaces must not become live runtime dependencies (except the allowlisted producer of that surface).
